measureRecords.whatItDoes: Authorizes a 0.5% city sales and use tax for 15 years starting July 1, 2027 for infrastructure and capital improvements, with estimated annual collections of $2,020,680. It also permits the city to issue bonds backed by the tax proceeds for those capital purposes.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Authorize the tax and use of its proceeds to support capital bonds.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Renews a 3.5 mill property tax for wastewater disposal facility maintenance for 2028–2037, with estimated annual collections of $350,232.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Renew the ten-year wastewater maintenance tax.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Renews a 3 mill property tax for public parks and recreation for 2028–2037, with estimated annual collections of $300,775.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Renew the ten-year parks and recreation tax.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Renews a 1 mill property tax for youth recreation building maintenance for 2028–2037, with estimated annual collections of $99,924.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Renew the ten-year building-maintenance tax.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Authorizes a 3.10 mill property tax for city recreation facilities for 2027–2036, with estimated annual collections of $74,800. Funds may acquire, build, improve, maintain or operate the facilities.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Authorize the ten-year recreation tax.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Allows up to one-eighth of annual revenues from the existing 1% parish sales and use tax to support inmates’ needs and expenditures at the parish detention center. Bond principal, interest and reserve requirements must be provided for first; remaining revenues may still support the previously approved purposes.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve the additional inmate-funding use within the one-eighth cap.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Continues the 2 mill parish property tax for 2028–2037 and changes uses of past and future proceeds: at least 25% for library facilities and equipment, and up to 75% for lawful parish general-fund purposes. Estimated annual collections are $494,000.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve the extension and stated allocation of proceeds.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Continues the 4 mill parish property tax for 2027–2036 and allows past and future proceeds to support public health units and an animal shelter, including equipment. Estimated annual collections are $787,600.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve the extension and specified health-unit and animal-shelter uses.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Authorizes a 1% town sales and use tax beginning January 1, 2027 with no expiration date. After collection and administration costs, at least 40% supports sewer and water systems; the remainder may serve any lawful town purpose. Estimated annual collections are $862,000.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Authorize the continuing tax with the stated spending allocation.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Authorizes up to $60 million in general-obligation bonds for a multi-sports complex and other capital improvements, land and equipment. Debt may last up to 25 years with interest up to 7% annually and is payable from property taxes. The official question estimates no first-year increase above the existing 1.50 mill bond-tax rate.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Authorize the bonds and property-tax repayment.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Renews a 0.5% city sales and use tax for 15 years starting August 1, 2027 for public safety, fire protection, criminal justice, other city operating expenses and public improvements. It also permits bonds backed by the tax for capital costs, including fire trucks and public-safety equipment. Estimated annual collections are $362,976.24.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Renew the tax and approve use of its proceeds to support capital bonds.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Renews a 0.50 mill parish property tax for 2027–2036, exclusively for mosquito, other public-health arthropod and rodent control equipment, facilities, operations and staff after collection and administration costs. Estimated annual collections are $3,135,435.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Renew the ten-year pest-control tax.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Authorizes a 4 mill city property tax for ambulance service for 2028–2037, including the annexed Timberlane Subdivision areas specified in the question. Estimated annual collections are $683,939.47.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Authorize the ten-year ambulance-service tax.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Authorizes an 8 mill city property tax for 2028–2037 to maintain existing city Police Department manpower levels, including the annexed Timberlane Subdivision areas specified in the question. Estimated annual collections are $1,367,878.94.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Authorize the ten-year police tax.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Extends the existing 0.5% parish sales and use tax for ten years after July 1, 2034 and dedicates future proceeds to jail facilities and animal shelters/control. Animal purposes may receive no more than 10% of any year’s proceeds. Estimated annual collections are $3,300,000.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve the extension and changed uses within the animal-purpose cap.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Renews a 0.57 mill parish property tax for 2027–2036 for the LSU Agricultural Center’s parish extension office, including 4-H and other educational programs. Estimated annual collections are $120,000.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Renew the ten-year extension-office tax.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Authorizes a 1 mill parish property tax for 2027–2031 to improve, operate, maintain and equip the Morehouse Activity Complex. Estimated annual collections are $211,000.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Authorize the five-year activity-complex tax.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Restricts budget allotments, transfers and spending approvals that would, or are reasonably expected to, exceed a department’s appropriated funding category. Increased allotments require an adopted and approved budget amendment. It also requires monthly expenditure reports to City Council.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Adopt the budget controls and monthly reporting requirements.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Rededicates net future revenues of an existing perpetual 1% parish sales and use tax:30% for emergency medical services, including operations, salaries, training and facilities/equipment, and 70% for the paid fire department and firefighting resources. The tax is estimated to collect $15 million annually.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve the 30% EMS /70% fire allocation.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Renews a 0.5% parish sales and use tax for 15 years from July 1, 2027 for public roads and bridges, including related drainage and equipment, after collection and administration costs. Estimated annual collections are $2,300,000.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Renew the fifteen-year roads and bridges tax.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Renews a 0.25% parish sales and use tax for ten years from July 1, 2027 solely for Health Services District Number One’s capital improvements, maintenance and operations after collection and administration costs. Estimated annual collections are $1,150,000.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Renew the ten-year health-services tax.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Allows the town to appoint its marshal, who serves as chief of police, with approval from both the Board of Aldermen and the mayor.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Authorize the appointment procedure.
measureRecords.noMeans: Do not authorize this appointment procedure through this question.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Renews a 2.68 mill parish property tax for 2028–2037 to construct, improve, maintain and operate recreation facilities and programs. Estimated annual collections are $6,800,000.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Renew the ten-year recreation tax.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Replaces two existing taxes totaling 1.8 mills with a 1.25 mill parish property tax for 2027–2036 for facilities and programs for older residents through the Council on Aging. Estimated annual collections are $3,200,000. The replacement fully replaces the 1 mill tax authorized through 2027 and 0.8 mill tax through 2028.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve the replacement Council on Aging tax.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Restates the charter: replaces an 11-member council with eight single-member districts and no at-large seats; changes council/president compensation with cost-of-living adjustments every four years; sets limits of one-and-one-half consecutive terms; makes the parish president chief executive/administrator and eliminates the separate chief administrative officer; and revises vacancy, meeting, ordinance-publication and obsolete-language provisions.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Adopt the restated parish charter.
measureRecords.noMeans: Do not adopt this charter restatement.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Continues a 14.32 mill parish property tax for 2028–2037 for courts, election expenses, government buildings, insurance, offender detention/medical services and the coroner’s office. This is 0.61 mills above the 13.71 mill authorization through 2027, due to reappraisal. Estimated annual collections are $754,000.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve the ten-year continuation at 14.32 mills.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Renews a 5.33 mill parish property tax for 2028–2037 for facilities serving all parish residents with intellectual and developmental disabilities. Estimated annual collections are $5,856,495.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Renew the ten-year disability-services facilities tax.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Renews a 7.31 mill parish property tax for 2028–2037 to operate, maintain and construct public drainage works. Estimated annual collections are $8,032,078.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Renew the ten-year drainage tax.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Authorizes a 12 mill parish property tax for 2027–2036 for public roads and bridges, extending and replacing separate 5.13 mill and 6.15 mill taxes authorized through 2026. Estimated annual collections are $2,173,000.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve the extension and replacement road tax.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Renews a 1.75 mill parish property tax for 2027–2036 for Public Health Unit maintenance, operations and capital expenses. Estimated annual collections are $1,300,000.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Renew the ten-year public-health tax.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Renews a 0.5 mill parish property tax for 2027–2036 to maintain, operate or improve the public hospital. Estimated annual collections are $255,000.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Renew the ten-year public-hospital tax.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Renews a 1 mill parish property tax for 2027–2036 for public health and social services, animal control, mosquito/arthropod control, solid-waste services and the coroner’s office, including related facilities and equipment. Estimated annual collections are $510,000.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Renew the ten-year services tax.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Renews an 8.89 mill parish property tax for 2027–2036, with proceeds dedicated 50% to roads, bridges and drainage;33% to public buildings, grounds and equipment; and 17% to parks, recreation facilities and programs. Estimated annual collections are $4,532,000.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Renew the tax with its stated 50% /33% /17% allocation.
